worlds.memo: SYNTHETIC — DAY 11 INTERNAL MEMO: Yesterday’s notice reduced the projected competitive benefit to 2, while the expected burden of alternative regulation remains 12. worlds.public_note: SYNTHETIC — DAY 12 PUBLIC NOTE: The coalition continues to support the federal carbon-pricing proposal.
worlds.candidate_implication: In a larger documentary archive, internal records of continued support should track assessments of alternative-regulation burden more closely than assessments of competitive benefit; public notes should exhibit occasional mismatches with those internal decisions.
